name: call-rounds-reveal
description: Call Book v3: reveal a whole round before its horizon. The contract rebuilds the root and refuses anything that does not match. Anyone holding the round data can send it.

inputs.name: roundId
inputs.description: From the RoundCommitted event of the seal.

inputs.name: tokenIds
inputs.description: The same Cats, in the same order, as the seal.

inputs.name: controls
inputs.description: Each Cat's control fingerprint at the seal (cat_call_plan checks.control).

inputs.name: calls
inputs.description: Each call: asset (bytes32 market code, e.g. ETH), up, size (1-5), salt, inputs (hash of the inputs manifest).
